name: Flinders Peter Torjul Interstate Student Scholarship
summary: $10,000 a year for up to four years for interstate students (outside SA and NT) with financial need starting a Flinders degree.
key: $10,000 per annum for up to four years.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder
Apply through SATAC with an eligible Flinders course as first preference
Receive means-tested government payments or demonstrate financial hardship
Permanent residential address in any Australian state or territory other than South Australia or the Northern Territory
how: Apply online through the Flinders University Student System by the closing date
catches: The 2026 round opened 15-12-2025 and closed 06-02-2026; check for the next round
Cannot be held with other major University scholarships

source.label: Flinders University: The Peter Torjul Interstate Student Scholarship

evidence.quote: permanent residential address in any Australian state or territory
